text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Members of the Disciplinary Committee, volunteers of Ritto Dorm!
Thank you very much for gathering!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Exterminating the ghost that haunted our dorm...
We will definitely see it through!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ossu! It's all to protect
our peaceful academy life! The whole committee is here!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
According to King-san,
"The ghost has been on an even greater rampage lately."
We must discipline it quickly and put her mind at ease!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
That suspicious light appeared around here...
—Eek, kyaah!? T-That light just now!
I-I-Is it a ghost!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, nope! That is not a ghost,
it is just that person's flashligh—

text_block_list.name: Dignified Disciplinary Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
What, a ghost!?
Over there!? Hold it right theeeere!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah!? No, you're mistaken!
Waaaait up!!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Ow... ouch!?
Don't just jump out like that!
I was thiiis close to catching it!

text_block_list.name: Feisty Disciplinary Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
You jumped out all of a sudden too, didn't you!
Ah, jeez! I fell right on my butt...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Fault on both sides!!
Neither of you should be charging around corridor corners!!

text_block_list.name: Loud Disciplinary Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Ouch! Hey, who did that!?
Who caught me in a bug net!!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, I'm sorryyy~!
I thought you were the ghost~~...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...This is looking pretty bad.

text_block_list.name: Ghost Extermination Squad
text_block_list.text: (*pant... pant...*)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Everyone is completely scattered and exhausted...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well... just brute-forcing it by "chasing whatever looks suspicious"
was bound to end up like this.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...In that case... I shall!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
! Don't tell me, Kawakami...
You're planning on chasing it all by yourself...!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Calm down! A solo charge is dangerous!
If you blow another hole in the wall—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Host a tea party!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo & Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

When I came to grab a light snack during my work break,
I spotted Kawakami Princess and the others.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"You can't fight on an empty stomach"—or rather!
You cannot wage battle while exhausted!!

text_block_list.name: Dignified Disciplinary Committee Member
text_block_list.text: ...A tea party, after all that?

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
My throat was super dry though, so this is perfect.
Running non-stop was really tough...

text_block_list.name: Dignified Disciplinary Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
That's true...
Taking a break somewhere might have been a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! Then let us take turns patrolling!
Anything else!?

text_block_list.name: Feisty Disciplinary Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
We crashed into each other in the hallway while chasing the ghost...
Maybe we could work out some signals to give each other.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I was wondering what you meant by "tea party"...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So it was a strategy meeting all along!
Everyone's really bonding now, looking good!
